errors.evidence: The categories on the horizontal axis are "Sports", "Community", and "Healthcare", which are not in alphabetical order.

errors.text_span: Each category features three stacked bars, representing “No Contact Before”, “Positive Contact Before”, and “Negative Contact Before” in light gray, red, and light blue respectively, as well as “No Contact After”, “Positive Contact After”, and “Negative Contact After” in dark gray, dark red, and dark blue respectively.
errors.evidence: The chart's structure is misinterpreted. Each category contains a group of three bars. Each of these three bars is a stacked bar. The bars themselves represent "No Contact", "Positive Contact", and "Negative Contact". The stacks within each bar represent the "Before" and "After" conditions. The description incorrectly states there are three stacked bars and conflates the bar categories with the stacking categories.

errors.text_span: For Sports, the “No Contact Before” bar is approximately 45.42%
errors.evidence: This statement misinterprets how to read a stacked bar chart. The value 45.42% corresponds to the bottom segment (the "Before" value) of the "No Contact" bar, not the entire bar. The total height of that bar is the sum of the "Before" (45.42%) and "After" (7.45%) values. This error is repeated for all data points cited in the description.
The description fails to mention that the 'After' portions of the bars (described as dark gray, dark red, and dark blue) are visually distinguished with a hatched/striped pattern.

errors.text_span: The bars are not visually emphasized with any shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect. The 'After' segments use a hatched pattern, which is a form of shading. More significantly, every segment of every bar is explicitly annotated with its precise numerical value.
